items.title: Distribute Amazon RDS traffic between read replicas using Network Load Balancer
items.summary: Learn how to put Amazon RDS read replicas behind a Network Load Balancer with health-aware, Availability Zone affinity routing. An AWS Lambda function keeps the load balancer target group in sync with replica IP addresses, giving clients a single stable endpoint over Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN without AWS PrivateLink overhead.
items.creator: Vijay Chakraborty
